name: Project Wheels
description: A three.js portfolio hero for React: two wheels of work turn against each other, project cards on one and their marks on the other; the one at the nip grows into focus while its title rolls in like an odometer. Scroll, drag, flick or arrow keys, with a speed governor and a critically damped snap; cards bend like cloth with speed.

props.name: projects
props.type: {title: string; client: string; year: string; image: string; mark: string; color: string; href?: string}[]
props.description: The work. image fills the 16:9 card (remote hosts need CORS); mark and color draw the plate on the second wheel.

props.name: bend
props.description: How much the cards bend, shear and trail with the wheel's speed. 0 keeps them flat.

props.name: captureWheel
props.description: Turn the wheels with the mouse wheel / trackpad while the pointer is over the component (the page doesn't scroll then). Drag and arrow keys always work.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height (h-svh for a hero).
